title: 时间戳与 datetime 互转：utcfromtimestamp 为何已废弃
expected_output:
=== 时间戳 -> datetime 的显式时区写法（确定、可断言）===
fromtimestamp(ts, timezone.utc)  = 2026-10-08 12:00:00+00:00
fromtimestamp(ts, Asia/Shanghai) = 2026-10-08 20:00:00+08:00
等价的手写写法 (epoch + timedelta) = 2026-10-08 12:00:00+00:00
注: utcfromtimestamp 自 3.12 起已废弃(返回 naive), 新代码不要再用

=== 不传 tz 的危险: 结果由宿主本地时区决定 ===
fromtimestamp(ts).tzinfo = None -> naive (不含任何时区信息)
它 与 UTC 版本相等吗      = False (naive 与 aware 永不相等, 根本不是同一类对象)
真正危险的是: 它的年月日时分会被宿主时区整体平移, 同一份代码换台机器结果就变
-> 凡是依赖它的输出, 一律不能写进单元测试断言

=== 关键差异: tzinfo 与可比较性 ===
本地化版本的 tzinfo = None -> naive
UTC 版本的 tzinfo   = UTC
naive < aware -> TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes

=== 反向: datetime -> 时间戳 ===
aware.timestamp() = 1791460800 (不依赖本地时区语义)
naive.timestamp() = 1791460800 (往返等值, 但语义靠解释器猜本地时区)

=== 结论 ===
新代码统一 fromtimestamp(ts, timezone.utc); utcfromtimestamp 已是 deprecated
code:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

ts = 1791460800  # 2026-10-07T20:00:00+00:00
utc = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, timezone.utc)
sh = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai'))

print("=== 时间戳 -> datetime 的显式时区写法（确定、可断言）===")
print("fromtimestamp(ts, timezone.utc)  =", utc)
print("fromtimestamp(ts, Asia/Shanghai) =", sh)
print("等价的手写写法 (epoch + timedelta) =",
      datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=ts))
print("注: utcfromtimestamp 自 3.12 起已废弃(返回 naive), 新代码不要再用")

print()
print("=== 不传 tz 的危险: 结果由宿主本地时区决定 ===")
local = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
print("fromtimestamp(ts).tzinfo =", local.tzinfo, "-> naive (不含任何时区信息)")
print("它 与 UTC 版本相等吗      =", local == utc, "(naive 与 aware 永不相等, 根本不是同一类对象)")
print("真正危险的是: 它的年月日时分会被宿主时区整体平移, 同一份代码换台机器结果就变")
print("-> 凡是依赖它的输出, 一律不能写进单元测试断言")

print()
print("=== 关键差异: tzinfo 与可比较性 ===")
print("本地化版本的 tzinfo =", local.tzinfo, "-> naive")
print("UTC 版本的 tzinfo   =", utc.tzinfo)
try:
    local < utc
except TypeError as e:
    print("naive < aware -> TypeError:", str(e)[:60])

print()
print("=== 反向: datetime -> 时间戳 ===")
print("aware.timestamp() =", int(utc.timestamp()), "(不依赖本地时区语义)")
print("naive.timestamp() =", int(local.timestamp()), "(往返等值, 但语义靠解释器猜本地时区)")

print()
print("=== 结论 ===")
print("新代码统一 fromtimestamp(ts, timezone.utc); utcfromtimestamp 已是 deprecated")
